title: CIC: A Framework for Culturally-Aware Image Captioning
findings: Religion is included as one of five cultural categories to make image captioning more culturally aware. The framework's ability to extract religious components via Visual Question Answering (VQA) had a high match rate (0.84) with human participants' selections, indicating its effectiveness in identifying this cultural element to generate more descriptive captions.
